review.notes: All 240 entries were checked for completeness, valid response values, agreement-direction scoring, question identity, nonempty rationale and valid contextual source references. A distinct same-agent pass reviewed the 15 axis briefs and counter-evidence for each person, literal question wording, historical counterfactual limitations and selected primary sources; it is not a fresh independent source investigation of every response. Previously unresolved estimates are marked Educated assumption and low confidence; their question IDs and prior unresolved records are supplied in the batch review report. Neutral entries were retained where the contextual interpretation is mixed or conditional, including modern scenarios outside historical subjects’ lifetimes; they remain weak estimates rather than documented views. Direct evidence must not be inferred from a party label, personal faith, technological enthusiasm or a neighbouring profile. Targeted corrections separate AI opportunity from lethal targeting, Locke’s consent doctrine from universal modern suffrage, and embryo laboratory research from reproductive enhancement. Sources retain their original access records; research continuity does not assert every source was reread today. Close pairs are retained with documented distinctions, never adjusted to achieve separation. The owner explicitly requested best-effort answers to every question and will personally review the work. No independent human review or resolution of all evidence limitations is claimed.
